verdict.rationale: Encrypted sync and backup is a fair axis for a password manager, so the story applies. Nothing in the evidence pack covers end-to-end encryption of backups, keys the vendor never holds, or a published encryption design. The export/import docs and the CLI, Connect and SDK material are about other capabilities and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a security engineer, backups are end-to-end encrypted with a key the vendor never holds, and the encryption design is documented
